content: Isa Apetulatulaaka Ibaratina Kariaana Kawia
Kasiimpo apendua uka o Isa apogau tee apake ibarati.
"Pamarintana Aulataʼala sumai mboomo ibaratina samia raja mopadhaangiana kariaana kawia to anana umane.
Incia atumpu manga bhatuana to alingka akemba manga mia mopadhana ikembana i kariaa sumai, maka manga mia sumai amendeu aumba.

Kasiimpo raja atumpu uka bhatuana mosagaanana tee aposamea, 'Paumbaia manga kakemba sumai, 'Kinandena kariaa asiapumo, sapi tee manga anana sapi momalapena padhamo atosumbele. Bhari-bharia asiapumo, jadi uumbamo i kariaa sumai!'
Maka manga kakemba sumai inda afaduliakea. Dhaangia molingkana i inawuna, dhaangia moʼurusuna usahana.
Tee dhaangia uka morakona manga bhatuana raja sumai, kasiimpo asikisaaia tee apekamatea.
Sabutuna aʼamaramo mpuu o raja sumai, tee atumpumo manga tantarana mamudhaakana apabinasa manga mia mopekamatena bhatuana sumai tee atunu kotana manga incia.
Sapadhana sumai, apogaumo raja i bhatuana, 'Kinandena kariaa asiapumo, maka manga mia mopadhana ikemba inda alaenga to atokemba.
Rampaakanamo sumai, lingkamo i simpangana dhala tee ukemba malingu mia ipokawaakamiu iwe sumai to aumba i kariaa sii.'

Kasiimpo manga bhatua sumai alingka i dhala oge to aromusaka malingu mia ipokawaakana iwe sumai, dhaangia o mia madhaki tee dhaangia uka o mia malape. Sabutuna abukeakamo kakemba o tampana kariaa kawia sumai.
Wakutuuna raja apesua to apokawaaka manga kakemba sumai, incia akamatamo samia o mia inda mopakena bhaju molaengana to moumbana i kariaa.
Apogaumo o raja tee mia incia sumai, 'E witinai, pokia ingkoo upesua iwe sii tee inda upake bhajuna kariaa?' Maka o mia incia sumai soo atongo tee inda abhoasaka opeopea uka.

Sabutuna o raja sumai apogaumo tee manga bhatuana, 'Bhokea o limana tee aena mia incia sii kasiimpo utudhaakea i tampa momalalanda mpuu, i tampa incia sumai dhaangia tee tangi tee mopakiri-kirina ngincina.' "
Kasiimpo Isa aʼaahiri ibarati sumai tee apogau, "Abhari o mia ikemba, maka saidhemea motopilina."
Soʼalina Pomeaana Balasitee i Kaisar
Kasiimpo alingkamo manga mia minaaka i rombongana Farisi tee apomufakatiaka tuaapa o carana manga incia mamudhaakana amembali apetambo Isa tee opea ipogauakana.

Manga incia atumpu murina Farisi apobhawa-bhawa tee manga mia moalaakana Raja Herodes to aabhaki Isa, "E Guru, ingkami tamataua ande Ingkoo o mia mojujuru, tee uadhariaka kaadharina Aulataʼala tee kajujuru, tee inda umaeka i incemapo uka, roonamo Ingkoo inda upaposala-sala mia.
Rampaakanamo sumai, manga paumbaakapo tee ingkami tuaapa o fikirimu. Buaka amembali tapomea balasitee i Kaisar Roma atawa inda?"
Maka o Isa amataua o kadhakina ngangarandana manga incia. Kasiimpo Isa apogau, "E manga mia munaafiki, apokia gaumiu upetamboaku?
Susuakaaku o doi to upomeaaka balasitee sumai." Manga incia abhawa satibha doi pera to Isa.
Kasiimpo o Isa aabha i manga incia, "Gambara tee sarona incema sii?"

Alawanimo manga incia, "Gambarana Kaisar tee sarona Kaisar." Kasiimpo o Isa apogau, "Dhawuakea to Kaisar opea momembalina pewauana Kaisar, tee udhawuakea i Aulataʼala opea momembalina pewauana Aulataʼala."
Wakutuuna arango kalawanina Isa sumai, amentemo manga incia, sabutuna alingka tee abholi Isa.
Kaabhakina Manga Mia minaaka i Rombongana Saduki to Soʼalina Mobhanguna minaaka i Mate
Eo incia sumai uka, dhaangia moumbana i Isa o mia mominaakana i rombongana Saduki mokofikirina ande o mia mobhanguna minaaka i mate sumai inda dhaangia. Manga incia aabha i Isa,
"Guru, Musa manga paumba ande samia umane amate inda tee anana, witinaina tabeana akawi tee iaiarona sumai tee adhawuakea siwuluna to almarhum.

I piamo itu dhaangia pitu mia tapowitinai umane i tanga-tangana ingkami. Witinaina o tumpe amate sapadhana akawi maka inda tee siwuluna. Roonamo incia inda tee siwuluna, jadi iaiarona almarhum sumai akawiakamo witinaina almarhum.
Witinaina amatemo uka maka inda tee siwuluna. Giu incia sumai amembali uka tee lima mia witinaina mosagaanana, sampe witinaina umane pitu miana sumai aposamate.
Kasiimpo bhawine sumai amate uka.
Incema buaka i tanga-tangana pitu miana umane witinai sumai momembalina umanena bhawine siitu ande eona pabhanguana? Roonamo manga incia bhari-bharia padhamo amembali umanena."
Isa alawanimea kooni, "Ingkomiu ukalerumo mpuu, sababuna ingkomiu inda umaʼanaia Kitabi Momangkilo atawa kuasana Aulataʼala.
Roonamo wakutuuna bheapabhangua, manga mia inda bheakawi tee inda atopakawi maka bheadhadhi mboomo malaaʼekati i sorogaa.
Indapo mina buaka ingkomiu ubaca opea ipogauakana Aulataʼala to mia mate ipabhanguna pendua? Aulataʼala apogau,
'Iakumo Kawasana Opuna Ibrahim, Ishak, tee Yakub.' Incia mencuana Aulataʼala isombana manga mia mate, maka o mia modhadhi."
Wakutuuna mia bhari arango giu incia sumai manga incia amentemo tee opea iadhariakana.
Hukumu Mobhaa-bhaana
Wakutuuna manga mia minaaka i rombongana Farisi arango Isa inda apakoʼuu manga mia minaaka i rombongana Saduki, manga incia aporomusakamo.
Kasiimpo sala samia minaaka i manga incia, siitumo ahalii Hukumu Taurati aabhamo tee acobai Isa,
"Guru, parinta iapai mobhaa-bhaana i nuncana Hukumu Taurati?"
Alawanimo Isa, "Umaasiakea o Kawasana Opu Aulataʼalamu, tee mpuu-mpuuna incamu tee saangua dhadhimu tee bhari-bharia akalana budimu.'
Siitumo parintana bhaa-bhaana tee o giu momatamona mpuu.
Parinta rua anguna apokana tee bhaa-bhaana sumai, 'Umaasiakea o musirahamu mboomo umaasiaka karomu.'
Parinta rua angunamo sii moposaanguna tee mopotaangiakana bhari-bharia kaadharina Kitabi Taurati tee uka bhari-bharia kasameana Aulataʼala mopadhana motoburi minaaka i manga nabii."
Pokaina Isa tee Raja Daud
Tangasaana manga mia minaaka i rombongana Farisi dhaangia aporomu-romu iwe sumai, Isa aabhamo i manga incia,
"Opea fikirimiu to Raja Mopasalaamatina, Al Masi? Siwuluna incema Incia?" Lawanimo manga, "Siwuluna Raja Daud."
Apogaumo Isa, "Ande mboo itu, apokia o Raja Daud tee kuasana Rohina Aulataʼala Momangkilo asarongi Al Masi o 'Opu' wakutuuna apogau,

content.text: sakawana manga musumu kudhikaia i tambena aemu.'

content: Jadi ande o Raja Daud asarongi Al Masi 'Opu,' tuaapa amembali Incia o siwuluna Raja Daud?"
Inda dhaangia samia momembalina molawanina Isa. Tee apepuu eo incia sumai, indamo dhaangia mobaranina moabhaakana opeopea uka tee Incia.
